description: A cross-platform .NET library for SMB/CIFS file operations. Supports both Kerberos and username/password authentication. Works on Windows (native UNC) and Linux/macOS (via smbclient).
releaseNotes: v2.0.0-preview.9: PREVIEW - Fix production bug where newly-arrived files were invisible to EnumerateFilesAsync/EnumerateDirectoriesAsync (e.g. Helzberg import reporting "no files found" despite a matching file existing on the share). Root cause: CanConnectAsync (used by health checks) sent 'cd "path"; ls' to the smbclient session. Under the persistent session pool, "cd" permanently changes that pooled session's working directory for every future command that reuses the same slot; subsequent relative-path commands (e.g. "ls {path}/*") then silently resolved against the wrong directory. CanConnectAsync now uses an absolute path ('ls "/path"') instead of "cd", so it never mutates a shared session's working directory. v2.0.0-preview.8: PREVIEW - Fix critical production bug: the persistent smbclient session (session pool) sends commands to smbclient's interactive "smb: \> " prompt, which only accepts one command per line and does NOT understand ';'-separated command chaining (that only works with the one-shot "smbclient -c 'cmd1;cmd2'" invocation). CanConnectAsync builds commands like 'cd "path"; ls', which was sent as a single line and always failed once a persistent session was active - causing every SMB health check to report Unhealthy in production after the initial sessions were established. ExecuteAsync now splits ';'-joined commands and sends each one as its own line/prompt round-trip. Also: SmbClientFileHandler.CanConnectAsync no longer silently swallows the underlying exception - it is now logged as a warning so future connectivity failures are diagnosable. v2.0.0-preview.7: PREVIEW - Fix GitHub issue #4: FileHandler.WriteFileAsync/DeleteFileAsync/MoveFileAsync threw "Invalid SMB path format" on Linux/macOS when passed UNC-style paths (e.g. "//server/share/folder/file.txt"), because Path.GetDirectoryName/Path.GetFileName treat these as POSIX paths on non-Windows platforms and collapse the leading "//" to a single "/". Replaced with a manual path-splitting helper that is consistent across all platforms. v2.0.0-preview.6: PREVIEW - Add EnumerateDirectoriesAsync (list subdirectories) and GetFileInfoAsync (extended file metadata: altname, create/access/write/change times, attributes, and alternate data streams via smbclient's "allinfo" command) to IFileHandler/ISmbClientFileHandler, addressing GitHub issues #2 and #3. New SmbSharp.Models.SmbFileInfo result type. v2.0.0-preview.5: PREVIEW - Fix session-pool WriteFileAsync failing under WSL: pooled ExecuteAsync did not translate embedded Windows temp-file paths (e.g. "put C:\...\file remote") to their WSL /mnt/<drive>/... equivalents before sending to smbclient, unlike the non-pooled path. v2.0.0-preview.4: PREVIEW - Fix root cause of session pool hang: smbclient never emits its interactive prompt "smb: \> " at all (not just buffered) unless stdin is a TTY. Output buffering fixes alone (stdbuf) could not solve this. Now invokes smbclient through "script -qec" to allocate a real pseudo-terminal, restoring prompt output; verified end-to-end against a live share, including natively inside Linux (WSL) with no wsl.exe relay involved. v2.0.0-preview.3: PREVIEW - Fix session pool still hanging: line-buffering (stdbuf -oL) does not flush smbclient's interactive prompt "smb: \> " because it has no trailing newline. Switched to fully-unbuffered stdbuf -o0 -e0. v2.0.0-preview.2: PREVIEW - Fix persistent session pool hanging indefinitely: smbclient fully buffers stdout when not attached to a TTY, so the interactive prompt/banner could sit unflushed and never reach the reader. Now invokes smbclient via stdbuf -oL -eL to force line-buffered output. v2.0.0-preview.1: PREVIEW - Add persistent session pool support (UseSessionPool option) to avoid re-authenticating (full connect/negotiate/Kerberos handshake) on every smbclient call. Keeps a small pool of persistent, authenticated smbclient sessions per share; transparently recreates and retries once if a session dies mid-operation. v1.1.2: Repackage of v1.1.1 fixes with clean build (previous package contained stale binaries). Fix EnumerateFilesAsync on smbclient path: include files with any attribute (not just Archive), correctly parse filenames containing spaces, return empty list for empty directories instead of throwing, and include hidden dot-files. v1.1.0: Add macOS support (smbclient), WSL smbclient support on Windows (opt-in), and sample console app.
